message:
Every event on the Slate now gets its own poster.

Ethan Askey & The Elevators at the Fernie Legion get a gig poster. The 42nd Annual Rock Creek Christmas Market hangs on a market sign. Soft Rock Hard at The Royal in Nelson goes up as a flyer, and karaoke at the Creston Legion gets a handbill.

Tap any poster and it turns over. The back shows when and where, with buttons to add it to your plan or your calendar, share it with a friend, or get directions.

Find your next night out across the Kootenays at kootenayslate.ca
